create_ClassicTrainingParams: create a ClassicTrainingParams dataclass with seed, model, task, and optimizer settings for training
run_TrainingWorker: run a TrainingWorker to train a JAX model with length curriculum and optional range evaluation
update_parameters: update model parameters with a JIT-compiled SGD step using optax optimizer and gradient computation
apply_loss_and_metrics: apply loss and metrics computation to model outputs given a batch of inputs and targets
compute_range_evaluation: compute full range evaluation results across multiple sequence lengths after training completes
